Getting started

This guide explains how to install the example client and connect it to a workspace. It describes the configuration file, the authentication handshake and the common failure modes you may encounter.

The client reads a configuration file from the working directory and resolves the base URL from the EXAMPLE_HOST variable. See the configuration reference for the full list of options and their defaults.

Installation

Install the package with your package manager of choice. The install is idempotent and can be re-run safely after upgrading the runtime. 

import { createClient } from "example";

const client = createClient({ host: process.env.EXAMPLE_HOST });
await client.connect();

Configuration options

OptionDefaultDescription
host(required)Base URL of the workspace.
retries3Number of retry attempts.
timeoutMs5000Per-request timeout.

Troubleshooting

When the handshake fails, check that the host is reachable and that the clock is synchronised. A skewed clock invalidates the signed tokens and produces an authentication error even when the credentials are correct.

  • Verify the host resolves from the machine running the client.
  • Confirm the system clock is within a few seconds of UTC.
  • Re-run the install if the package version is pinned incorrectly.
